ITEM 1A - RISK FACTORS

Failure to meet the rapidly expanding demand for accelerated computing and AI infrastructure could harm our market leadership.

Our GPU architectures rely on complex global semiconductor supply chain partners, including third-party foundries and packaging vendors.

Export controls on advanced semiconductor devices and software imposed by the United States government have limited our shipments to certain regions.
